variants.name: Silent
variants.info:
Experimental XM115 made for 7.62x51mm NATO firearms.

Similar functions to a flash hider, reduces sound too.

Bullet speed and suppression reduced. Works great with suppressors!

variants.name: 7.62x51mm
variants.info:
A rechambering of the SVK-12 for 7.62x51mm NATO, intended for the export market. The SVK-12E foregos the trigger group of the 7.62x54mmR variant for a unique 2-round burst only trigger designed to improve shot accuracy at mid-range through volume of fire. It is dubiously effective.

Somewhat reduced damage, but overall improved recoil control..

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: 12.7x55mm
variants.info:
A rechambering of the SVK-12 for the relatively uncommon 12.7x55mm ammo type, typically used by special forces and police units for higher stopping power. Like many of the other AK-12 prototype variants, no real credible info exists on the development of this rifle in this chambering.

Very high damage with somewhat low muzzle velocity..

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).
